data.text:
[Traffic Advisory] NOTICE OF ROUTINE MAINTENANCE ON M1 AND M2 MOTORWAYS

@MyJRA wishes to inform road users of the routine maintenance currently underway on the M1 (northbound and southbound) between Grayston Drive and Shakespeare Avenue Bridge, and on the M2 (eastbound and westbound) from Lower Germiston Road to Main Reef Road. Roadwork will be active until the 30th of October 2025.

Lane closures will be effected from 09h30 - 15:00 during weekdays and between 07h30 – 16h00 on weekends.

Traffic delays are expected along the M1 and M2 sections during the maintenance period, therefore motorists are advised to plan their journey in advance, exercise caution on the roads and reduce their travelling speed for the safety of our maintenance teams and other road users.

We thank all road users in advance for their patience and cooperation.
#JoburgRoads #JoburgUpdates ^NJ

Mahalagang Abiso sa mga Motorista

Pansamantalang isasara ang isang lane ng South Bound ng Mindanao Avenue papunta sa may kanto ng Road 1 dahil sa isasagawang asphalt patching at sealing works bukas, October 11, 2025 mula 11:00 PM hanggang 8:00 AM ng October 12, 2025.

Bahagi ito ng isinasagawang konstruksyon para sa Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP).

Muling bubuksan ang nasabing lane sa Lunes, October 13, 2025 sa ganap na 4:00 ng madaling araw.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Nakaantabay naman ang mga tauhan ng Quezon City Traffic and Transport Management Department (QC-TTMD) at MMDA para umalalay sa daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing kalsada.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.
